Ref. No. AAVAS/SEC/2026-27/3384 
 
Date: October 26, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio recording of Earnings Conference Call for the quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, and with reference to our intimation dated October 13, 2026 vide               
Ref. No. AAVAS/SEC/2026-27/3317, please note that the audio recording of Earnings Call with 
investors/analysts held on Monday, October 26, 2026 to discuss the Financial and Operational 
Performance of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 has been 
made available on the website of the Company under the following link: 
 
  https://www.aavas.in/investor-relations/investor-intimation.  
 
Date and time of occurrence of event/information: October 26, 2026 and Earnings Call 
commenced at 06:30 P.M. (IST).  
 
You are requested to take the above on record. 
 
Thanking You, 
 
 
For AAVAS FINANCIERS LIMITED 
 
 
 
 
SAURABH SHARMA
